citations.quote: Tracking error The standard deviation of the differences between a portfolio’s returns and its benchmark’s returns; a synonym of active risk.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Tracking error (a synonym of active risk) is the standard deviation of the differences between a portfolio's returns and its benchmark's returns; it measures how tightly an active or index portfolio follows its benchmark and is the denominator of the information ratio (CFA L1).
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Tracking Error and Active Risk
